FAQ

Samsung repair FAQs

Why does my Samsung ice maker keep freezing up?

Ice builds up in the ice compartment when moisture gets in or the ice-room fan and defrost do not do their job. Chipping the ice out only helps for a while. We find the cause and fix it so it does not come back.

Are you Samsung authorized?

No, we are an independent licensed repair company. We use original Samsung parts bought from authorized distributors, with 1 year on parts and 90 days on labor.

Do you repair Family Hub refrigerators?

Yes, including cooling, ice and control faults. The cooling side of a Family Hub is the same as other Samsung models.

Can you read Samsung error codes?

Yes. Tell us the code when you book (for example 22E or 39E on a fridge, 5C or dC on a washer, HE on a dryer) and we come prepared.

How much does Samsung repair cost? (2026 prices)

Most Samsung repairs cost between $160 and $520 in 2026, parts and labor included. For example, heating element typically runs $180 – $340, while ice maker / ice room freezing up runs $220 – $400. The final price depends on the model and what the diagnosis finds.
